title: checkin_result payload, pv 1 (PROPOSED, docs/VUKA-2-SPEC.md §4b)
description: Committed private payload of a checkin_result event: a valid PIN was accepted at a check-in. `result: duress_pin` is a duress signal (§3); there is no separate duress_pin event kind. Numeric fields are integers (spec §5). Adding a field is a pv bump.

checkin_id.description: The checkin_id used in this check-in's checkin_opened payload.

result.description: Which PIN was accepted. no_answer is never device-authored; it is a server event (§8).

attempt.description: 1-based ordinal of the PIN entry on this check-in at which this PIN was accepted, counting every earlier wrong entry. Device-asserted (T47, ADR-0041): a normal_pin with attempt >= 4 follows three wrong entries, so the server appends it but it is never terminal and never retracts an alert. A duress_pin is a duress signal at any attempt.
